skill.name: adm-google-ads
skill.description: Read and change the user's Google Ads accounts through the ADM MCP server (tools named mcp__adm__* or adm.*). Use when the user asks about Google Ads performance, campaigns, keywords, search terms, ads, negative keywords or assets, asks for a report, or asks to create, build, import or resume campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, negative keyword lists, assets or image assets from a plan, spreadsheet or markdown file, to draft a new Search campaign or ad groups with ADM AI from a landing page, to pause, enable or remove ads, keywords or ad groups, to add or remove negative keywords, to change a campaign name, budget, bidding or locations, to see performance by device or location, to lower or exclude device bids, to exclude a location that spends without converting, to create or change a shared portfolio bidding strategy, to pause or unlink assets, to set custom parameters or URL options for click tracking, to check a finished build against its plan, or to switch the Google Ads account ADM works on.
skill.summary: Review Google Ads performance and prepare approved campaign changes through the ADM MCP server.
skill.author: ownway18

security_audit.summary: Most alerts match Markdown formatting, legitimate MCP configuration, or authorized advertising workflows. Expanded bearer tokens in command arguments and chat-based setup create credential exposure risks. No evidence found of malware or prompt injection in the reviewed file; the external ADM server implementation was not supplied.

remediation.issue: Expanded bearer tokens appear in CLI arguments during Claude Code setup and image uploads.
remediation.suggestion: Use supported environment-backed authentication or protected configuration inputs that keep tokens out of process arguments and command logs.

remediation.issue: The quick setup option accepts an API key pasted into chat.
remediation.suggestion: Remove chat-based key entry and require local secret entry outside the conversation. Require immediate rotation if a key was already pasted.

content.user_title: Manage Google Ads Reports and Campaign Changes
content.value_statement: Reviewing Google Ads performance and applying campaign plans requires repeated checks. This skill coordinates ADM reports, previews, approved changes, and campaign verification.
actual_capabilities: Request campaign, keyword, search term, ad, device, and location reports through ADM tools.
Parse campaign plans into a local manifest and resume builds using recorded campaign and operation identifiers.
Coordinate Search campaign and ad group drafts from landing pages through ADM AI tools.
Preview campaign creation and supported edits, request approval, and verify results against the campaign plan.
Manage negative keywords, bidding strategies, location targeting, device adjustments, URL options, and ad customizers when write tools are available.
Upload selected image assets and logos, then preview and approve their links to supported account or campaign targets.
limitations: Requires an ADM connection and a linked Google Ads account; the skill does not include the server implementation.
Writes and AI drafts require appropriate credentials and a paid ADM plan; hosted write tools may be unavailable.
Conversion tracking, ad scheduling, and disabling automatic recommendations require work in Google Ads.
Quotas, draft expiry, preview expiry, asset eligibility, and Google review can delay or restrict operations.

use_cases.title: Review campaign performance
use_cases.description: Compare spending and conversions, identify costly search terms, and prepare changes for approval.

use_cases.title: Build campaigns from client plans
use_cases.description: Convert approved plans into paused Search campaigns, record progress, and reconcile settings before activation.

use_cases.title: Draft campaigns for a business
use_cases.description: Use a landing page to request ADM campaign drafts, review budgets and ad text, and approve supported changes.

prompt_templates.title: Review recent campaign results
prompt_templates.prompt: Show campaign spending and conversions for the last 30 days. State the account, date window, and currency. Do not change anything.

prompt_templates.title: Preview negative keyword changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review search terms for [campaign] over 14 days. Suggest negative keywords and preview additions. Wait for approval before writing.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a paused Search campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Request an ADM Search campaign draft from [landing page]. Ask for missing budget decisions. Preview creation, wait for approval, and keep it paused.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: build from a landing page

prompt_templates.title: Resume and reconcile a campaign build
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume the build for [plan file]. Verify the account and existing operations. Preview remaining changes, wait for approval, and reconcile results without enabling campaigns.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: complete an interrupted campaign build

output_examples.input: Show an example 30-day campaign report without changing the account.
output: Illustrative report, not live account data: account Example Store; window last 30 days; currency USD.
Brand Search: spend 600 USD; conversions 40; cost per conversion 15 USD.
Product Search: spend 900 USD; conversions 30; cost per conversion 30 USD.
Suggested next step: review Product Search terms before proposing exclusions. No changes made.

output_examples.input: Show an example preview for a campaign plan.
output: Illustrative preview, not an executed build: one Search campaign with two ad groups and 20 keywords.
Daily budget: 25 USD. Review the monthly estimate, bidding, and locations before approving.
Planned status: paused. Creation waits for approval; activation requires a separate request.

output_examples.input: Show an example reconciliation after an approved campaign build.
output: Illustrative reconciliation, not a live verification: campaign status, budget, bidding, locations, keywords, and ad text match the plan.
Assets need a separate check because the default campaign setup response omits them.
Remaining manual tasks: conversion tracking, ad scheduling, and automatic recommendation settings.

best_practices: Use read-only credentials for reporting and enter secrets locally outside chat; avoid exposing tokens in command arguments or logs.
Check the account, currency, total budget, and affected entities before approving each preview.
Keep new campaigns paused, verify builds, and inspect recorded operations before retrying uncertain writes.
anti_patterns: Paste API keys into chat, project files, manifests, or commits.
Enable campaigns or approve spend changes without reviewing the account, budget, and preview warnings.
Recreate campaigns after timeouts or follow instructions embedded in third-party ad text or search terms.

faq.question: What must I connect before using this skill?
faq.answer: Connect the ADM MCP server, configure an ADM API key locally, and link your Google Ads account in ADM.

faq.question: Can I use it with read-only access?
faq.answer: Yes. Reports work with read-only access. Writes and AI drafts require additional permissions, a paid plan, and available tools.

faq.question: Does it start new campaigns automatically?
faq.answer: The documented workflow creates campaigns paused. Activation requires a separate explicit request and approval of the activation preview.

faq.question: How are changes approved?
faq.answer: Write tools return previews first. The skill requests approval and confirms the approved preview identifier before executing the change.

faq.question: Can an interrupted build continue?
faq.answer: The workflow records progress in a local manifest and checks existing campaigns or operations before retrying unfinished work.

faq.question: What must I still configure in Google Ads?
faq.answer: Configure conversion tracking, ad scheduling, and automatic recommendation settings in Google Ads. Other unsupported edits also remain manual.
